88093: Yuki Takeya is the main protagonist of the Gakkou Gurashi! series.
88359: Kurumi Ebisuzawa is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School and the primary "zombie killer"/strategist of the School Life Club, where her abilities prove invaluable.
88361: Yuuri Wakasa is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School. As the big-sister figure, Yuuri is the president of the School Life Club, where she is more commonly referred to as "Rii (-san)".
89054: Miki Naoki is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a second year student of Megurigaoka High School. She eventually joins the School Life Club as the youngest member after being rescued during the members' outing to the mall.
89055: Megumi Sakura is a Japanese teacher at Megurigaoka Private High School and the faculty adviser for the School Life Club. She is affectionately called "Megu-nee" by her students (rather than her preferred "Sakura-sensei").
89057: In the anime, Taromaru is notably an intelligent and tolerant dog, putting up with anything Yuki puts him up to and being able to open doors and escape. He is able to avoid infected citizens and escape to the safety of Kei and Miki, and is later found by Kurumi in the mall.
138630: She is the Leader of the "Degeneracy Club", later Renamed "The Circle", and is the most notable Gamer in the series, even getting yelled at in Vol.10 for "spewing her Gamer Brain" onto others.
